summary.text: Rick Billinger is a Republican member of the Kansas Senate representing District 40 (Sherman County), and the Legislature's member page lists service in the Senate since 2017.
Rick Billinger is listed as chair of the Ways and Means Committee.

paragraphs.text: According to the same page, Rick Billinger served in the House (2011–2012) and the House (2015–2016) before the current service in the Senate that began in 2017.
Rick Billinger is listed as a member of the Ways and Means Committee and the Government Efficiency Committee.
The Legislature lists Rick Billinger's occupation as Retired Businessman and Farmer.
The page names Rita Billinger as Rick Billinger's spouse.
